# Launch apps and tune channels

The media player starts apps and tunes channels with `media_player.play_media`.

## Launch an app

**Launch Netflix**

```yaml
service: media_player.play_media
target:
  entity_id: media_player.lg_webos_tv
data:
  media_content_type: app
  media_content_id: netflix
```

The integration also launches an app when `media_content_id` is a full app id such as `com.webos.app.youtube`, whatever the content type. To pass parameters, use [launch_app](../reference/services.md#bscpylgtvlaunch_app).

## Tune a channel

**Tune a channel by number and name**

```yaml
service: media_player.play_media
target:
  entity_id: media_player.lg_webos_tv
data:
  media_content_type: channel
  media_content_id: "5 ARD"
```

The integration matches `media_content_id` in this order: exact channel number, exact channel name (case-insensitive), then a partial name. An unmatched value fails with `Channel 5 ARD not found in the channel list.`

## Pick a source

`media_player.select_source` takes an app or input title from the source list. Choose which titles appear in [Options](../reference/options.md). An unknown title fails with `Source <name> not found in the sources list for <tv>.`

## Open a URL

**Open a web page**

```yaml
service: bscpylgtv.command
target:
  entity_id: media_player.lg_webos_tv
data:
  command: system.launcher/open
  payload:
    target: https://www.youtube.com
```
